suggested_fix: No security fix needed. The release callback drops the delegation reference taken when the CB_GETATTR was queued (nfs4_put_stid), so the delegation cannot be freed while the callback is in flight. As a hardening/clean-up step, clear_bit() + wake_up_bit() could be replaced with clear_and_wake_up_bit() so the barrier between clearing the bit and waking the waiters is guaranteed.
